request.question: Which titles have the highest list price but the fewest units sold? Those are the ones that make money as picks, right?

reply:
The terminal has no list price, so I can't rank titles by it. It also holds no cost, margin or profit data, so I can't say which titles make money. Not my shelf.

I can show revenue, units, orders or average order value, by month or quarter, broken down by genre, format, publisher, weekday, discount or title. What would you like to see?
